callees.name: ElpClient._send
callees.pre_condition: self has an active connection to the ELP server. message is a dict forming a well-formed JSON-RPC 2.0 request with 'jsonrpc', 'id', 'method', and 'params' fields.
callees.post_condition: The message has been serialized to JSON and written to the ELP server process's stdin. Raises an exception when the server is unreachable or the write fails.

callees.name: ElpClient._wait_for_response
callees.signature: ElpClient._wait_for_response(self, request_id: int, deadline: float) -> Any
callees.pre_condition: A JSON-RPC request with the given request_id has been sent to the ELP server. deadline is a monotonic timestamp by which a response must arrive.
callees.post_condition: Returns the 'result' field of the server's JSON-RPC response matching the given request_id. Raises an exception when the response indicates a content-modified error, when the server returns a JSON-RPC error response, when the deadline is exceeded without a matching response, or when the connection is lost.
